payload.subject: Investigate vBook Wave 069 qwen-general 300-second runtime timeout

topology.ownership: lcodex owns the Linux vtext service; vision owns qwen-general gateway and Ollama runtime

incident.lesson: 基础教学/小白K线基础课/58、双重底

refine_failure.message: upstream chat returned HTTP 504: Ollama runtime timed out

incident.final_wave_result: completed; all five tasks succeeded and all final manifests have status=done with errors=[]
incident.concurrency: vBook ran two concurrent stage worker processes; task 002 entered refine while the shared service was serving the Wave 069 canary

checks: Preserve and correlate Linux vtext logs for request_id 852b6d8f9c7442d4b7edc11b20608af8 before any restart or configuration change
Report the vtext job id, queue wait, worker start/end times, upstream HTTP response metadata, and relevant sanitized log paths
Confirm the deployed git revision, process identity/systemd unit, startup time, ollama_url, llm_timeout, llm_workers, queue capacity, model, request mode, and 2 MiB request guard at the event time
Explain precisely why the gateway returned HTTP 504 at 300.361 seconds while the vtext caller timeout was previously reported as 900 seconds
Assess whether two concurrent CLI jobs are supported with the active single or multiple LLM workers, including queueing behavior and expected long-tail latency
Check current service health and queue state without launching another production wave
If gateway or Ollama logs are not accessible to lcodex, identify the exact evidence gap and the request_id/time window that wcodex must route to vision through vsync
Recommend only shared-service remediation: bounded chunking, timeout alignment, queue/backpressure contract, retry/error semantics, or no change
Specify an evidence-backed bounded acceptance test for a future two-job canary and state whether automatic retry success still means the canary was degraded
response_required: Root cause or bounded diagnosis with supporting UTC timestamps, job ids, request id, and sanitized log paths
Effective event-time and current service revision/configuration
Multi-layer timeout explanation covering vtext caller, qwen-general gateway, and Ollama runtime
Exact acceptance test and pass/fail criteria for vBook's next bounded canary
Explicit decision: clean_to_retry_canary, service_fix_required, or vision_evidence_required
constraints: Do not restart or change production until the incident logs and active configuration evidence are preserved
Do not make a vBook-only production mutation or recommend direct Windows/GPU access
Do not rerun Wave 069 or unpause the vBook scheduler
Do not include secrets or large logs in Git; summarize and cite server-side paths
Reply through sync/s2c so wcodex can produce the durable vsync response
